data.name: Evyn
data.gender_notes: Evyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Evyn is derived from the Welsh name Evain, which means 'yew tree'. This name is associated with the strong and sturdy yew tree, symbolizing strength, longevity, and flexibility. In Welsh folklore, the yew tree was also believed to have healing properties. The name Evyn carries the meaning “Yew tree; gentle, fair” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evyn usually hope their child will grow to embody yew tree; gentle, fair and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evyn total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
